text: Stillness agents have been seen near the main Engine. They're planning something.
The Stillness leadership has called for a cease-fire. They want to negotiate.
The Stillness is recruiting from the desperate. They promise an end to suffering.
A whole district went silent overnight. No screams, no struggle. Just gone.
They've unearthed a relic that drinks sound. Near it, even prayers die in the throat.
A Stillness defector hides in the lower wards, begging passage out of the Reach.
If the Engine stops, the Stillness say, the Bloom stops with it. They mean to try.
The Stillness once swore a pact with the Compact. The terms are coming due.
